verdict.headline: Warsh debuts at Jackson Hole with framework focus, avoids rate signals; market holds
verdict.label: Neutral keynote leaves September hike odds at ~33%; 30Y at 5.20%, inside trigger; BTC breaks $80K
verdict.rationale_short: Warsh's first Jackson Hole address centered on monetary policy framework reform and financial innovation rather than signaling a September decision, leaving hike odds at ~33% and the 30Y at 5.199% — 10bps inside the 5.30% regime trigger. Markets closed flat to modestly positive; MRVL's -8% premarket selloff on a genuine beat ($2.74B revenue, $0.94 EPS, $3.15B Q3 guide) extended the high-multiple compression pattern from CSCO and AMAT in August. BTC cleared $80,000 for the first time, supported by the non-hawkish backdrop. If the 30Y closes above 5.30% post-September 16 FOMC, this read changes.

trade_setups.thesis: 30Y at 5.199% is the tightest margin from the 5.30% trigger since August 12's soft CPI read. Warsh's neutral keynote prevented a Friday breach but did not close the setup. The next trigger candidates: the August jobs report (first Friday of September, est. September 4) and Canada's September 8 retaliatory tariffs. A hot payrolls print alongside tariff cost-push framing in Fed communications would be the two-variable case for a 5.30% breach before the September 16 FOMC.
trade_setups.entry: 30Y above 5.30% on a daily close activates the regime framework. 30Y sustained below 5.10% after the jobs report — absent a tariff surprise — would signal the trigger is formally deactivating through the September FOMC window.
trade_setups.invalidation: 30Y close below 5.10% on above-average volume in the wake of soft jobs data would indicate the regime risk has formally receded.

trade_setups.asset: MRVL — altitude reset vs. structural support
trade_setups.thesis: MRVL opened Friday at ~$218, near the August 1 earnings base at $215-220. The Google custom-silicon deal ($12.2B), raised FY27/FY28 outlook, and +37% YoY revenue confirm the thesis; the -8% premarket is a multiple-compression event on margin-compression expectations, not a fundamental challenge. The reset is an altitude recalibration — whether it is contained at the earnings base or extends lower defines the next phase.
trade_setups.entry: Two consecutive regular-session closes above $230 on above-average volume would signal absorption. A close below $210 would indicate the recalibration is extending toward the July gap fill at $195-200.
trade_setups.invalidation: Regular-session close above $230 on volume above the 30-day average within the next three sessions.

trade_setups.thesis: BTC posted $80,257 on Friday — the first daily close above $80,000 after four sessions that tested and failed. The Warsh-neutral backdrop removed the tightening headwind; the Bessent buyback program (starting September 9) provides structural demand. One close above $80K is not confirmation. The question is whether the holiday-weekend session and the first September trading day (September 2 after Labor Day) sustain the level.
trade_setups.entry: Two consecutive daily closes above $80K confirm the resistance level has flipped. The August 24 intraday low at $76,661 is the nearest structural support if the break does not sustain.
trade_setups.invalidation: A close below $76,661 on the first September trading day (September 2) absent a macro catalyst would signal range-top behavior rather than a confirmed break.

bear_case: Warsh's deliberate ambiguity is itself the risk. By framing 'big questions' without answering the market's central one — September hike or hold — he left the three-way July dissent (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan) as the primary signal for the September 16 FOMC. The 30Y at 5.199% is 10bps from a regime trigger with two structural catalysts still ahead: Canada's September 8 tariffs and the August jobs report. MRVL's -8% on a genuine beat is the third confirmation that high-multiple AI infrastructure outside NVDA reprices at any shortfall — the CSCO/AMAT template is now a pattern, not an outlier. If the August jobs report prints above expectations and Canada tariff cost-push enters the Fed's communication in September, the 30Y breaches 5.30% and the rate-regime framework activates simultaneously with stretched tech multiples. If SPX closes below 7,600 after the September 16 FOMC, the current read no longer holds.
